verdict.rationale: Copilot's first-party docs describe connectors that link Copilot to OneDrive, Outlook.com email and calendar, Google Drive, Gmail and Google Calendar so it can find, summarize and act on that data. They give concrete example prompts for searching files, finding emails and checking calendar events, and note the connectors are available on Copilot.com and the mobile apps. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the consumer connectors (the one positive community comment refers to the Microsoft 365 integration, not these connectors), and documentation of the connection/authorization flow.
